## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from APA publisher pages (apa.org/pubs/journals/cou) and domain knowledge of APA Division 17 (Counseling Psychology) editorial culture. Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | Very High — counseling psychology has strong multicultural tradition |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium-High |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | Very High — race, gender, LGBTQ, intersectional counseling well-represented |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Counseling psychology — career development, multicultural counseling, vocational psychology, identity-process counseling, prevention, positive psychology |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **counseling-psychology contribution** — career, multicultural, vocational, identity-process, or prevention focus.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Manuscripts redirected to JCCP if clinical-only or J Voc Behavior if career-only.

| Mixed methods | 5 | Common |
| Meta-analysis | 5 | Welcomed |

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts outside counseling-psychology scope
- AI use without disclosure per APA policy
- Deficit-framing without strengths consideration

### Soft Tax

Low for counseling-tradition authors. Multicultural / positionality framing expected.

### Best Suited For

- Multicultural counseling research
- Career / vocational psychology
- LGBTQ-affirmative counseling
- Race / Ethnicity counseling
- Identity-process studies
- Prevention research
- Mixed-methods counseling work

### Not Recommended For

- Pure clinical psychopathology (consider JCCP, J Psychopathology)
- Pure I/O career (consider Personnel Psych)
- Pure social psychology

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology](./journal-of-consulting-and-clinical-psychology.md) | If treatment-focused; APA family |
| 2 | [Counselling Psychology Quarterly](../psychology/counselling-psychology-quarterly.md) | T&F counseling peer |
| 3 | [Journal of Vocational Behavior](../psychology/journal-of-vocational-behavior.md) | If career-focused |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from JCCP as "too counseling-focused," J Counseling Psychology is the natural APA Division 17 home.
